clue.text: Both universities in Boat Race steer to go across

parts.note: a steer is a castrated bull, and an ox is the same animal
to bridge a gap is to span or go across it

explanation.surface: A rowing coach urges the cox to cut across the course during the famous varsity race.
explanation.walkthrough: The Boat Race is the annual rowing contest on the Thames between Oxford and Cambridge universities.
explanation.definitionFit: The blend name covers Oxford and Cambridge together, the two crews that contest the Boat Race.

clue.text: Quick look is barely sufficient when lacking time

indicators.note: lacking says a letter is missing from the word for barely sufficient

parts.note: scant means barely enough, meagre

explanation.surface: A hurried glance is hardly adequate if you are short of time.
explanation.definitionFit: To give something a quick glance over is to skim it, a brief survey.

clue.text: Best gear from very narrow railway

parts.note: fine can mean very thin or slender, as in a fine thread

explanation.surface: Smart clothes are on sale from a tiny narrow-gauge line.
explanation.definitionFit: Showy clothing worn for an occasion; one's Sunday best or glad rags.

clue.text: Accepted a deadly sin

parts.note: avarice, or greed, is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: Someone admits to committing one of the seven deadly sins.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean having consented to or gone along with a proposal.

clue.text: One yelling when son's given milk substitute

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son; the 's stands for has
creamer is a powdered or liquid whitener used in coffee instead of milk

explanation.surface: A child howls on being handed non-dairy whitener rather than real milk.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who shrieks or cries out loudly is a shrieker or howler.

clue.text: Lad's carrying a key for trunk

indicators.note: carrying means the word for lad holds the key letter within it

parts.note: a lad is a boy; the 's stands for is
D is a musical key

explanation.surface: A boy carries a key to unlock a large chest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunk' looks like a storage chest beside the key, but it means the torso.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk is the torso, the main part of a human frame apart from head and limbs.

clue.text: Very demanding former partner playing a role

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse or partner
acting is performing a part

explanation.surface: An ex-spouse who is a performer proves hard to please.
explanation.definitionFit: Exacting describes something that makes great demands, rigorous and strict.

clue.text: Cut policeman seen around hospital

indicators.note: seen around says the policeman word encloses the hospital letter

parts.note: cop is slang for a policeman
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A wounded officer is spotted near the hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: To chop is to cut with a heavy blow, as with an axe.

clue.text: British eleven in Paris gets medal for third place

parts.note: onze is French for eleven

explanation.surface: A British football eleven playing in Paris finishes third.
explanation.definitionFit: Third place in Olympic-style events earns the medal ranked after gold and silver.

clue.text: All extremely to the right of Europe's leader

indicators.note: in an across answer, to the right of means coming after the other piece
leader picks the first letter of the word Europe

parts.note: very means extremely, to a high degree

explanation.surface: Every party sits far to the political right of Europe's leading figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely to the right' reads as politics, but 'to the right of' only places VERY after E.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words cover each and the whole of a group without exception.

clue.text: Regret regularly taking route

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word route, starting with the first

explanation.surface: A traveller keeps wishing they had chosen a different road.
explanation.definitionFit: To rue is to feel sorrow or remorse about something done.

clue.text: Misfit featured in heartless old ditty

indicators.note: heartless removes the central letter of each word, old and ditty

explanation.surface: An outsider stars in a soulless antique song.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' acts on both words: OLD loses its L and DITTY one of its central Ts.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddity is a strange or eccentric person, someone who does not fit in.

clue.text: Interior finished as planned

parts.note: INT is the abbreviation for interior, as in film scripts
ended means finished

explanation.surface: The decorators completed the inside of the house exactly to schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Something intended is meant or designed, done on purpose.

clue.text: Downgrade daughter and show real feeling

parts.note: to emote is to show emotion, often theatrically

explanation.surface: A parent demotes their daughter, and she reacts with genuine emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to reduce someone to a lower rank or status.

clue.text: Cross people talking madly in centre of eatery

indicators.note: the clue word that signals this step
centre of takes the middle two letters of the six-letter word eatery

parts.note: ravers are people who rave, talking wildly or incoherently

explanation.surface: An angry diner hears wild chatter from the middle of a restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like an adjective for the angry diner but is the verb, to go across.
explanation.definitionFit: To traverse is to travel across or through an area.

clue.text: Confer most appropriately over wicket

parts.note: best can mean most suitably, as in what is best done
O is the cricket scorer's abbreviation for an over
W is the cricket abbreviation for wicket

explanation.surface: A cricket official decides how to award a fitting honour for an over that took a wicket.
explanation.definitionFit: To bestow is to grant or present an honour or gift.

clue.text: Unfortunate to start being sick after first sign of winter

indicators.note: after puts the sick-making piece behind the winter letter
first sign of picks the opening letter of the word winter

parts.note: to retch is to heave as if about to vomit

explanation.surface: Someone begins to feel ill as soon as the cold season appears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unfortunate' is a noun here, an unfortunate person.
explanation.definitionFit: An unfortunate is a pitiable, unhappy person, a poor soul.

clue.text: Current master needs replacing

indicators.note: needs replacing says the letters of master must be put in a new order

explanation.surface: The present headteacher ought to be swapped out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like an adjective, but it is the noun: a flow of water.
explanation.definitionFit: A stream is a continuous flow of water or air moving in one direction.

clue.text: Make excessive demands on second rail service

parts.note: a train is a service run on the railway

explanation.surface: Running an extra train service overstretches the network.
explanation.definitionFit: To strain something is to overtax it, pushing it beyond its limits.

clue.text: Root vegetable loses half to decay

indicators.note: loses says a letter is taken away from the vegetable word

parts.note: a root vegetable such as a carrot or turnip is simply called a root
half of the doubled OO in the middle is a single O

explanation.surface: A turnip left too long has half of it go off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half' refers to the vegetable's pair of Os: one of the two goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Rot is decomposition, the process of going bad.

clue.text: Tree-lined street — not a place for meetings

indicators.note: not means the following letter is left out of the street word

parts.note: an avenue is a broad road, typically lined with trees

explanation.surface: A leafy road is no spot for gatherings.
explanation.definitionFit: A venue is the place where an event or gathering is held.

clue.text: What starts venting oxygen into dark empty space

indicators.note: the starts of the next four words are taken, one letter from each

explanation.surface: A machine vents oxygen into a dark vacuum.
explanation.definitionFit: A void is a vacuum or completely empty expanse.

clue.text: Free study under a jockey?

parts.note: to rid is to free or clear of something
a den is a private room for work or study

explanation.surface: An apprentice is released from his studies to serve a jockey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under a jockey' looks like a placement instruction, but it is the definition: a horse with a jockey on it is being ridden.
explanation.definitionFit: A racehorse carrying a rider is being mounted and steered, so it is in the saddle's charge.

clue.text: Cook complete bird that's long dead

parts.note: to do food is to cook it, as in done to a turn
to do a task is to complete it

explanation.surface: A chef finishes preparing a fowl that expired ages ago.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless Mauritius bird was hunted to extinction in the seventeenth century.

clue.text: Tackle English bird of prey

parts.note: tackle means equipment or gear, as does kit

explanation.surface: A sportsman wrestles with an English raptor.
explanation.definitionFit: A kite is a hawk-like raptor with a forked tail.

clue.text: Mostly cold item on menu suitable for a youngster

indicators.note: mostly drops the last letter of the cold word

parts.note: a chill is a coldness
a dish is a course or item of food on a menu

explanation.surface: A cold dish on the menu is suitable for a child.
explanation.definitionFit: Childish describes what belongs to or befits a child, as in childish games.
